Switzerland’s National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) has confirmed the country’s first known cyberattacks involving AI tools.

It says that in every case known to it, AI use led to a successful compromise of the target’s systems.

The affected organisations included companies and critical-infrastructure operators in at least two sectors.
